mapper.sql: q.id, q.enquete_id, q.question_text, q.question_type, q.is_required, q.display_order, q.created_at, q.updated_at, q.answer_pattern_id, ap.id AS ap_id, ap.pattern_name
mapper.select: SELECT FROM questions q LEFT JOIN answer_patterns ap ON q.answer_pattern_id = ap.id ORDER BY q.display_order
SELECT FROM questions q LEFT JOIN answer_patterns ap ON q.answer_pattern_id = ap.id WHERE q.id = #{id}
SELECT FROM questions q LEFT JOIN answer_patterns ap ON q.answer_pattern_id = ap.id WHERE q.enquete_id = #{enqueteId} ORDER BY q.display_order
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO questions ( enquete_id, question_text, question_type, is_required, display_order, answer_pattern_id, created_at, updated_at ) VALUES ( #{enqueteId}, #{text}, #{type}::question_type, #{required}, #{displayOrder}, #{answerPattern.id}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt} )
mapper.update: UPDATE questions SET enquete_id = #{enqueteId}, question_text = #{text}, question_type = #{type}::question_type, is_required = #{required}, display_order = #{displayOrder}, answer_pattern_id = #{answerPattern.id}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id}
